query: UPDATE jobs SET status = CASE WHEN attempts >= $3 THEN 'failed' ELSE 'queued' END, locked_until = NULL, last_error = $4, updated_at = now(), run_after = CASE WHEN attempts >= $3 THEN run_after ELSE now() + make_interval(secs => LEAST(60, power(2, attempts))::float8) END WHERE id = $1 AND attempts = $2 AND status = 'running'
